name: cavemio-comparison-table
title: Comparison table
description: Plans side by side, with a column that glides to the plan under your pointer and prices that roll.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A real table to assistive tech: column headers for plans, row headers for features, and ticks read as "Included" or "Not included".
- Section headers are buttons with aria-expanded; folded rows are inert.
- The gliding column is decoration only and follows a mouse or pen, not touch.
- Installs Pricing toggle (and with it Number roll). With reduced motion the column jumps and nothing slides.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: yearlyBadge

useCases.title: Pricing pages
useCases.description: Plans side by side with the features that separate them.

useCases.title: Billing and upgrade screens
useCases.description: Show what the next plan adds, inside the product.

useCases.title: Editions and licences
useCases.description: Compare editions of a product, a template or a self-hosted tool.

useCases.title: Feature matrices
useCases.description: Docs pages that compare options row by row.

features.title: One plan to read down
features.description: The recommended plan sits in an outlined column the full height of the table, and it glides to the plan under the pointer.

features.title: Monthly or yearly
features.description: The prices roll to the new period. Plans without a yearly price stay as they are.

features.title: Sections that fold
features.description: Each group of features folds open and shut, so a long table stays scannable.

features.title: Headers that stay in view
features.description: The plan headers stick under your navbar while the features scroll by.

features.title: One plan at a time on phones
features.description: Below 640px a plan switch replaces the columns, and the chosen plan slides in.

features.title: A real table
features.description: Plans are column headers and features are row headers, and ticks read as “Included” or “Not included”.

states.title: rest
states.description: The featured plan’s column is outlined and tinted from its header to the foot of the table.

states.title: point
states.description: The column glides to the plan under the pointer (520ms, slight overshoot) and back to the featured plan when the pointer leaves. Touch doesn’t move it.

states.title: billing
states.description: Prices roll to the new period; plans without a yearly price stay put.

states.title: groups
states.description: A section’s rows fold to nothing over 460ms as their contents fade; the chevron turns.

states.title: phone
states.description: Below 640px, a plan switch replaces the columns: its thumb is thrown to the plan and the column slides in 8px from the side you went.
